description: This file defines functions to generate and sanitize an OpenAPI/Swagger specification for an Express application, including loading a prebuilt spec or generating one from JSDoc annotations as a fallback.

methods.name: buildCommonComponents
methods.description: Builds reusable OpenAPI components such as parameters and schemas.

methods.name: buildJsDocSpec
methods.description: Creates an OpenAPI spec from JSDoc annotations in route files.

methods.name: sanitizeOpenApiDoc
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates an OpenAPI document object.

methods.name: getBaseOpenApiSpec
methods.description: Main exported function to retrieve the base OpenAPI specification, loading from file or generating dynamically.
